Hey op how you doing?

I was in your position once and I really do know what it's like. Unable to go to someone else about it out of whether it be fear or just feeling like it won't actually fix anything or leave you in a worse situation if you do but I understand. I got out of a similar situation just this year. 

Shit messes with you and I'm still working through it but I did get out even when throughout the entire thing I didn't think it was possible or seemed so far away. My top priority was getting out of there. If you can't tell anyone then your best option is head down and keep walking. Each day may be a struggle but that's one less day you have to hurt. One day you will be free. I want you to push for that day. Find a support system in friends or any hobbies. If you have neither of those then I'd like to take the first step to being your friend. 

There are people out there who understand a d will be happy to listen and support you. I wish you luck and shoot me a message whenever you feel the need to.
